note: Real bus reports (archived raw polls) for core/idle.js; inputs from experiments/routeknower/E28-scripts/make_golden.py, expect = web/js/core/idle.js idleStep chained poll by poll (nowS = feedTs = the poll's header time), computed in headless Edge. The iOS Kit IdleTests replays the same file.
format: cases[i] = {name, polls: [{h, v: [[veh, route_id, lat, lon, report time]], p: [[veh, latest predicted time]]}], expect: [[hidden vehicle ids] per poll]}; service = the Nov 5 2026 timetable, idle = web/data/idle.json

idle.note: Where and from what time buses of a route linger at the end of their shift (RouteKnower E28, experiments/routeknower/E28-scripts/idle_rules.py --write-idle). A bus still for 3 min at a spot of its route after `after` (service-day clock, may pass 24:00) never served riders again in the data; used only while today's listed hours of the route are one of `hours` and before valid_until.
